svg.title: The FurSight kit: two pet cams, the FurSight Tray and the app

g.text: Two pet cams and a smart litter tray watch the small daily things that change first. The app turns them into a diary,
alerts and a weekly card. Ray-Ban Display and Quest are optional extras.
hay, food, water, poses and flops
follows him when he roams free
in view, so FurSight sees them go
Weighs him and what he leaves at every visit. Fewer visits
or less output is one of the earliest signs of gut stasis.
him and what he leaves, to the gram
Pictures, his weight and the room go up; verdicts and alerts come back.
shared diary, live pet cam relay,
can he eat this? pet cam
Schematic, not to scale. In the hackathon build the cams are any webcam or old phone running the FurSight cam page (following him
uses digital zoom); the Tray's scale and sensors are simulated in the app, and labelled as simulated wherever they show.
